input_manifest.real_coordinates: Root-relative non-root joints, forward root displacement per frame in channels 0:3 (not velocity per second).
input_manifest.reconstruction: Decode full 54-code real sequence cached during supervised smoke encoding of 432 padded frames; score only valid frames 120:360.
input_manifest.repetitive: Repeat source generated frames 120:240 twice; seam at native frame240 (4 s), unsmoothed.
input_manifest.nearly_stationary: Real pose at frame120, fixed root, rigid yaw amplitude0.5degrees at0.5Hz; phase zero at audit origin.
input_manifest.scoring_context: Released reward called on cropped 240-frame controls. Gaussian smoothing sees crop boundaries; no full-rollout context. This is a reward-function audit, not exact replay of RL minibatch decoding (typically224 frames).
